## Summary

A concise description of the feature you would like to see.

## Problem it solves

What limitation or workflow pain does this address? Who benefits from it?

## Proposed behavior

How you expect the feature to work.

## Area

Which part of the project does this concern?

- [ ] Raster editing (brush, eraser, filters)
- [ ] Vector editing (`engine-v2`)
- [ ] Layers and compositing
- [ ] PSD / project I/O
- [ ] Selection and masking
- [ ] Color management
- [ ] Rendering / performance
- [ ] UI / UX
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Alignment with project goals

Pizzico is offline-first, deterministic, and free of proprietary cloud AI. Please
confirm how the request fits these constraints:

- [ ] Works fully offline
- [ ] Deterministic (no opaque cloud inference)
- [ ] Can be implemented from public specifications or peer-reviewed literature

## References

Cite public specifications, standards, or academic papers where applicable.
This project follows a strict clean-room methodology.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or alternative approaches you have in mind.
